title: Finite generation of bounded finite-model constructible complexes by strata
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every scheme $T$, put $B_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and use the ordinary uncompleted category $D(B_T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_T})$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Let $X$ be a scheme with Noetherian underlying topological space (descending chains of closed subsets stabilize). Let $\mathscr C$ be an isomorphism-closed class of objects of $D(B_X)$ containing zero, closed under all integer shifts and under extensions: if $A\to B\to C\to A[1]$ is distinguished and $A,C\in\mathscr C$, then $B\in\mathscr C$ [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Suppose $v_!t_*L[0]\in\mathscr C$ for every open immersion $v:V\hookrightarrow X$, every reduced closed immersion $t:S\hookrightarrow V$, and every $B_S$-module sheaf $L$ with a finite constant local model [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek, def-sfb-module-lower-star, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-reduced-scheme, sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Then every $K\in D(B_X)$ with bounded constructible cohomology in the finite constant local model sense of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] lies in $\mathscr C$. Only finitely many extensions and shifts are needed for each $K$. The assertion includes arbitrary condensed coefficients and integral torsion local models.

proof.text: Define a finite construction certificate for an ordered finite family: each entry is zero, a stratum generator, isomorphic to an integer shift of a strictly earlier entry, or the middle vertex of a distinguished triangle whose outer vertices are strictly earlier entries. Define Built(K) by existence of such a certificate and an entry isomorphic to K. Order-preserving embeddings transport certificates; concatenation and appending a final entry therefore prove that Built is invariant under isomorphisms, contains every zero and generator, and is closed under shifts and middle-term extensions. For extensions transport the given triangle along the two endpoint isomorphisms. These are finite tuple constructions, not a choice of objects from an unproved existence theorem.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-finite-model-stratum-filtration] to each constant-model constructible module F. It supplies monic successive maps between the open-supported pieces, zero initial piece, a final counit isomorphism to F, and natural cokernel isomorphisms to the open extension of the reduced closed stratum restriction. Evaluation at F preserves cokernels, identifying the objectwise cokernel of each monic map with exactly an allowed stratum generator, whose finite local model is supplied by the same filtration theorem.

proof.text: Each monic map and its cokernel give a short exact sequence of modules. Apply the degree-zero single-object triangle (Mathlib ShortComplex.ShortExact.singleTriangle_distinguished, the degree-zero specialization of [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle]). Induction on the finite filtration, using the zero initial piece, the generator quotient and the extension closure of Built, constructs F[0]. Transport through the final counit isomorphism. This also covers filtration length zero.

proof.text: Constant-model constructibility is invariant under isomorphism: transport the same finite stratification and its pro-etale trivializing covers; compose the local model isomorphisms with the inverse image of the given isomorphism. For every q, the singleFunctors shift isomorphism identifies F in degree q with F[0] shifted by -q, so Step 3 and shift closure construct it. Apply the existing proved finite Postnikov devissage [lem-sfb-degreewise-bounded-devissage], via its bounded wrapper DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded_of_degreewise, to the object property Built and the constructibility property in every degree. The boundedness and cohomology hypotheses are precisely the two components of constantModelBoundedConstructible. This yields Built(K), including acyclic K and empty support intervals. The derived category and its t-structure are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Strong induction on the finite certificate indices shows that each entry lies in the given class C: use its zero-object, generator, integer-shift, isomorphism and middle-extension closure in the four cases. Transport the designated endpoint isomorphism to obtain C(K). Append K as a zero shift of that endpoint, using the zero-shift isomorphism, to make the last entry isomorphic to K. Unpack the certificate to get exactly the displayed finite-list statement with strictly earlier indices. No retract, infinite coproduct, coefficient field, Tor-amplitude assumption, or inversion of torsion is used.
